# discord_text_channel (Resource)

Manages a Discord text channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_text_channel" "officer_log" {
  server_id                = "123456789012345678"
  name                     = "officer-log"
  sync_perms_with_category = false

  permission_overwrites = [
    {
      id    = "123456789012345678" # @everyone
      type  = "role"
      allow = 0
      deny  = 3072 # View Channel and Send Messages
    },
    {
      id    = "234567890123456789" # Officers
      type  = "role"
      allow = 1024 # View Channel
      deny  = 0
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the text channel (1-100 characters).
- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID where the channel will be created.

### Optional

- `category` (String) The ID of the parent category channel.
- `nsfw` (Boolean) Whether the channel is NSFW.
- `permission_overwrites` (Attributes Set) The complete set of channel permission overwrites. When set, at least one overwrite is required, sync_perms_with_category must be false, and separate discord_channel_permission resources must not manage this channel. Discord overwrites omitted from the set are removed. Omit this attribute to leave overwrites unmanaged by the text channel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permission_overwrites))
- `position` (Number) The position of the channel in the channel list.
- `rate_limit_per_user` (Number) Slowmode rate limit in seconds (0-21600). 0 means disabled.
- `sync_perms_with_category` (Boolean) Whether to sync permissions with the parent category.
- `topic` (String) The channel topic (0-1024 characters).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the channel.

<a id="nestedatt--permission_overwrites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permission_overwrites`

Required:

- `allow` (Number) Allowed permission bits, or zero.
- `deny` (Number) Denied permission bits, or zero.
- `id` (String) Discord role or member ID. Use the guild ID for @everyone.
- `type` (String) Overwrite target type: role or member.
